scope: Strategy allocation study, not a cross-sectional factor screen
signal_venue: Binance spot daily completed closes, official monthly archives with checksums
execution_venue: Binance USDT perpetual native Freqtrade, canonical 5m-derived hourly execution plus5m detail
train_boundary: Source README's original 1247-bar train window; fixed before local selection or returns
pair_tests: All45 unordered pairs, both OLS directions; select smaller train p-value
naive_selection: Source residual adfuller autolag=AIC, p<.05; heuristic, not a valid EG size claim
adjusted_selection: Control statsmodels.coint trend=c, autolag=AIC, p<.05; both directions retained under same best-direction rule; no familywise correction claim
beta: Static train OLS with intercept, never refit on evaluation
zscore: Trailing30 complete daily spread closes, sample SD, includes completed signal day
state: Source thresholds entryabs>2, exitabs<.5, stopabs>4; new entries only flat; flat beyond4 still enters per actual source code; no same-bar reversal
initial_state: Each spread starts flat before2024Dec31 decision; preceding30days seed z only, no evaluation warmup or prior account returns
timing: Signal dayT-1 completed close, target onT00 UTC signal row, native1h lag toT01 with5m detail
local_portfolio: Each selected pair has fixed1/K gross budget including inactive pairs; dependent1 and independent-beta normalized by1+abs(beta), net all pair legs per symbol. No redistribution from inactive pairs. Native actual quantities resized daily at01 using99% marked NAV
controls: GrossOneRiskTS source trend policy on same10perpetuals, source parameters and extra T-2 lag unchanged; comparison control, not a newly accepted alpha
margin: 3x CROSS native margin configuration for all; pair target aggregate gross<=1 beforelot/cash/price drift; actual exposure must be measured
combination: Strict hourly sum of actual500-USDT pair and500-USDT trend accounts, separately for each selector and cost; no scaled1000 path, transfers or year resets
gates: Positive fullwindow and both continuous calendar slices, DD<=50%, pair beats same1000trend and combination beats best1000component at bothcosts; numerical gate alone is not qualification
non_independent_oos: Source publication/selection history overlaps evaluation; all data are retrospective, not independent OOS
no_rescue: No post-result signs, thresholds, train dates, sourcepool, weights, fees or account dates changed
resource_guard: One financial worker at once,3GiB RSS,1hour per worker,2GiBfree beforeworker; only lossless byte-identical storage dedup allowed
